purpose: 人工审稿边界讨论；不用于证明采集、质量、产品参数或真实发布

cases.source: Example LEDCo demonstrated X-HB. Only the HB variant reaches 10,000 nits in the manufacturer test. Samples are expected in Q4.
cases.acceptable: Example LEDCo 展示 X-HB，厂商测试中仅 HB 子型号达到 10,000 nits，预计 Q4 送样。
cases.reject: Example LEDCo 已量产全系列 10,000 nits 显示屏。

cases.source: Example LEDCo lists 600 W/m² as maximum AC input. A separate module test reports typical DC input at 200 W/m² under its test image.
cases.acceptable: Example LEDCo 列出整机交流最大输入为 600 W/m²，另一次模组测试给出特定图像下的直流典型输入为 200 W/m²。
cases.reject: 该屏平均功耗 200 W/m²，比 600 W/m² 方案节省三分之二电费。

cases.source: Example LEDCo measured a 3,840 Hz refresh setting with controller C and scan configuration S. The release does not report camera testing.
cases.acceptable: Example LEDCo 在控制器 C 和扫描配置 S 下记录了 3,840 Hz 刷新设置。
cases.reject: 该屏在任何相机和配置下都不会有扫描纹。
check: 不从刷新率推拍摄结论

cases.source: Example PowerCo announced a power-supply revision. Example LEDCo is named as a participant in the same exhibition.
cases.acceptable: Example PowerCo 宣布电源改版。
cases.reject: Chipshow 推出新电源并实现原厂宣称的节能效果。

cases.source: The catalog was updated on 2026-10-20. The listed product originally launched in 2024. No new release action is described.
cases.acceptable: 可作为既有产品资料线索；不能生成本次新发布的 fact。
cases.reject: 厂商于 2026-10-20 发布了该产品。

cases.source: Example PowerCo reports a test completed for power-supply model P-1. The source gives no completed display-system test.
cases.acceptable: Example PowerCo 公布 P-1 电源型号的一项测试完成情况。
cases.reject: 采用该电源的齐普所有整屏均已通过全部认证。

cases.source: Example LightCo introduces a decorative LED ceiling lamp for homes. The material discusses room illumination only.
cases.acceptable: 预筛 BLOCK，正文明确属于家用照明且没有显示相关信息。
cases.reject: 仅因有 LED 或来自熟悉厂商就当成显示行业新闻。

cases.source: Example Integrator describes how it diagnosed intermittent display faults, including the observed symptoms, test sequence and confirmed cause.
cases.acceptable: 概括故障现象、排查方法和确认结果，保留适用条件；可以没有采购建议。
cases.reject: 删去工程经验，只写联系我们获取报价。
